async def act(page):
    # Navigate to the group settings page
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Settings').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Assuming the members section is accessible, look for a way to add members
    # This might involve clicking a 'Members' tab or link
    # Since the tree doesn't show details, I'll try to find common elements
    try:
        # Look for a 'Members' link or tab in the settings page
        await page.get_by_role('link', name='Members').click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    except:
        # If not found, the members interface might be on the same page
        pass
    # Now, add each member
    members = ['ASWATFZLLC', 'patrickhlauke', 'westurner', 'linkmatrix']
    for member in members:
        # Look for an input field to add a member
        await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Add member').fill(member)
        # Look for a button to add the member
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='Add member').click()
        # Wait briefly for the action to complete
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # After adding all members, wait for the page to stabilize
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
